data.summary: Most extracted plan attribution and limits are supported by the PDS, but several fields omit printed “No cover” values where the canonical definitions call for not-covered limits to be captured, and Basics appears to overstate natural-disaster cover for the relevant cancellation/disruption/travel-delay benefit areas.

findings.reason: Standard Saver has Travel Delay Expenses printed as No cover, but the extraction leaves the limit null. The field definition expects not-covered limits/status to be captured as printed.
findings.source_quote: Benefit limit allages | $2,000 | $2,000 | $2,000 | $2,000 | No cover | No cover

findings.reason: Standard Saver has Delay of Luggage and Personal Effects printed as No cover, but the extraction leaves the limit null.
findings.source_quote: Benefit limit allages | $750 | No cover | No cover | $750 | Nocover | $750

findings.reason: Standard Saver has Theft of Cash printed as No cover, but the extraction leaves the money limit null.
findings.source_quote: Benefit limit allages | $250 | No cover | No cover | $250 | Nocover | $250

findings.reason: Basics is marked as included for natural-disaster cover, but the relevant cancellation/trip disruption/travel delay benefits are shown as No Cover for Basics. For this field’s cancellation/additional-expenses/travel-delay scope, included is not supported.
findings.source_quote: Trip DisruptionExpensesRefer to page 47. | $50,000* | $30,000* | No Cover

findings.reason: Domestic Plus has overseas emergency medical and hospital expenses printed as No cover, but the extraction leaves the emergency medical limit null. The canonical field says to preserve not-covered values where printed.
findings.source_quote: Benefit limit69 years ofage & under | Unlimited | Unlimited | Unlimited | Unlimited | Unlimited | No cover

findings.reason: Domestic Plus has overseas emergency dental printed as No cover, but the extraction leaves the emergency dental limit null.
Domestic Plus has COVID-19 overseas emergency medical cover printed as No cover, but the extraction leaves the COVID medical limit null.
